name: Thrifty - API
description:
A simple web application that helps you manage your income and expenses. It's focused on simplicity and is not aimed to track every single penny you spend. The idea is to get a rough overview of your monthly cash flow and what's left to spend. 
        [br]
        This is the backend component of the Thrifty stack. It is designed to be used in conjunction with the Thrifty UI.
requires: Requires a separate Thrifty API container.

paths.name: Database Path
paths.description: Path to the SQLite database files

variables.name: Internal Database Path
variables.description: Path to the SQLite database file inside the container. Not recommended to change.
